title: adjustTrackerModelByHistory
responsibility: Advance along the eligible Tracker model ladder when similar attempts fall below the success threshold.

inputs.name: adjustTrackerModelByHistory.ladder
inputs.description: Eligible models in ascending capability order.

inputs.name: adjustTrackerModelByHistory.history
inputs.description: Successes and failures on similar tasks, by model rung.

inputs.name: adjustTrackerModelByHistory.minSamples
inputs.description: Minimum comparable attempts required before escalation.

inputs.name: adjustTrackerModelByHistory.upBelow
inputs.description: Success-rate threshold below which Tracker tries the next rung.

outputs.name: adjustTrackerModelByHistory
outputs.description: Index of the selected rung and the historical reasons for escalating.
